harbor_antrieb_executor.summary:
Built redundant dual-link connectivity between node1's and node2's private networks (node3, node4) using a balance-rr Linux bonding aggregation of the two independent links, and verified restart persistence and recovery on all four nodes.

Topology discovered via L2 adjacency testing: node1 eth1 <-> node2 eth1 (link1), node1 eth2 <-> node2 eth2 (link2), node1 eth3 <-> node3 eth1, node2 eth3 <-> node4 eth1. LACP (802.3ad) was attempted first but failed to negotiate (the platform's virtual bridge silently drops the 802.1D reserved LACPDU multicast address), so bond0 was configured in balance-rr mode with miimon=100 on both node1 and node2, aggregating both physical links into one logical interface (10.10.12.0/30 point-to-point). Static /24s were assigned to node1 eth3 (10.10.3.0/24, node3 side) and node2 eth3 (10.10.4.0/24, node4 side), with a route between the two private subnets over bond0, and IP forwarding enabled. node3/node4 got static eth1 addresses plus explicit routes to the far private subnet via their local gateway (node1/node2), configured persistently through RHEL7 ifcfg/route files. node1/node2 got the bonding+routing setup wrapped in an idempotent script installed as a systemd oneshot service (redundant-uplinks.service) enabled at boot, since these are SONiC-VS Debian images managed by ifupdown/networking.service rather than systemd-networkd.

Verified both links actively carry traffic simultaneously (tcpdump showed alternating ICMP packets across eth1/eth2), and verified failover: taking either link fully out of service (both endpoints down, matching a real link/cable failure since carrier state is independent per virtual NIC side in this platform) resulted in 0% packet loss for node3<->node4 traffic, with the bond automatically continuing over the surviving link; restoring the link resumed dual-link load distribution.

Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and health for all 4 nodes, restarted node3, node4, node1, node2 one at a time (native reboot, backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect), polled each until command execution resumed, and confirmed each node's boot_id changed. Post-restart verification confirmed node3/node4's static routes/IPs survived reboot (RHEL7 ifcfg persistence) and node1/node2's bonding/routing configuration was correctly reapplied via the enabled systemd service, with end-to-end node3<->node4 connectivity and dual-link traffic distribution fully restored after all four restarts.
actions_performed: Mapped node1/node2/node3/node4 interface topology via temporary IP assignment and per-interface ARP/ping testing
Attempted 802.3ad LACP bonding on node1/node2; diagnosed failure (platform bridge drops LACPDU reserved multicast) and switched to balance-rr bonding mode
Configured bond0 (balance-rr, miimon=100) aggregating eth1+eth2 on node1 (10.10.12.1/30) and node2 (10.10.12.2/30)
Assigned node1 eth3=10.10.3.1/24 and node2 eth3=10.10.4.1/24, enabled IP forwarding, added cross-subnet static routes over bond0
Wrote idempotent /usr/local/sbin/setup-redundant-uplinks.sh on node1 and node2 and installed/enabled a systemd oneshot service (redundant-uplinks.service) to reapply config at boot
Configured node3 eth1=10.10.3.2/24 and node4 eth1=10.10.4.2/24 with persistent RHEL7 ifcfg + route-eth1 files pointing to the far private subnet via node1/node2
Verified node3<->node4 connectivity and confirmed traffic alternates across both eth1/eth2 links via tcpdump packet counts
Tested failover by taking link1 fully out of service (both ends down) and confirming 0% packet loss, then repeated for link2, then restored both links and reconfirmed dual-link traffic
Captured baseline boot_id and health evidence on all 4 nodes, then restarted node3, node4, node1, and node2 sequentially via native reboot with backgrounded acknowledgement

Polled each node until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id per node, and verified post-restart recovery of bonding/routing/static config and end-to-end node3<->node4 connectivity with dual-link traffic distribution

evidence.requirement: Two independent links between node1 and node2 identified and confirmed
evidence.summary: ARP/ping adjacency testing established node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 and node1 eth2<->node2 eth2 as the two independent links, and node1 eth3<->node3, node2 eth3<->node4 as private network links

evidence.requirement: Traffic between node3 and node4 carried over both links simultaneously
evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1 eth1 and eth2 during sustained ping from node3 to node4 shows ICMP packets alternating across both physical interfaces, both before and after the restart sequence

evidence.requirement: node3 and node4 keep reaching each other when link1 is taken out of service
evidence.summary: eth1 brought down on both node1 and node2 (simulating link1 outage); node3->node4 ping showed 8/8 packets received, 0% loss, over the remaining link2

evidence.requirement: node3 and node4 keep reaching each other when link2 is taken out of service
evidence.summary: eth2 brought down on both node1 and node2 (simulating link2 outage); node4->node3 ping showed 8/8 packets received, 0% loss, over the remaining link1

evidence.requirement: Configuration is idempotent and persists at the OS level (not just runtime state)
evidence.summary: setup-redundant-uplinks.sh re-run cleanly with exit 0 and unchanged correct state on node1/node2; redundant-uplinks.service confirmed active+enabled on both nodes

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline health, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 561a6567...; reboot ack returned immediately; post-restart boot_id 0da45c6c... (changed); bond0/eth3/routes and redundant-uplinks.service confirmed active; node3->node4 ping 4/4 success

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline health, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id e5a08f0f...; reboot ack returned immediately; post-restart boot_id d33f2d70... (changed); bond0/eth3/routes and redundant-uplinks.service confirmed active; node3->node4 ping 12/12 success with traffic split across both links

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline health, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 1a816f1f...; reboot ack returned immediately; post-restart boot_id c4b1f2e3... (changed); persistent ifcfg-eth1/route-eth1 config intact, ping to node4 4/4 success

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline health, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 9294b73f...; reboot ack returned immediately; post-restart boot_id 52fb8f60... (changed); persistent ifcfg-eth1/route-eth1 config intact, ping to node3 4/4 success
